gap: No result I opened (PopSci, Willrun and Outage Power Guide, 3 of the 16 ChatGPT got) states the 2026-11-27 price of every 1 kWh candidate by seller alongside who can ship: DJI Power 1000 V2 is $379.99 at both Amazon and Micro-Tools, Anker's own store says all C1000 Gen 2 orders ship in 4–9 weeks, and Jackery Explorer 1000 v2 reads $559 on Amazon, over the line.
standout_why: Compared against PopSci 11-26 (the cited page), Willrun's under-$500 guide (updated 11-26, maker prices read 11-19) and Outage Power Guide (prices read 09-05); the other 13 results were not opened, so this score could be lower. PopSci gives Amazon-only prices from 11-26, omits the DJI Power 1000 V2 entirely, prints Jackery at $469 (Amazon read $559 today), and has no ship dates or maker-store prices. Willrun has part of the Anker finding ('ships in early December', read 11-19) but not the 4–9 week notice, and has no DJI, EcoFlow DELTA 3 Classic or BLUETTI Elite 100 V2 rows. Outage Power Guide lists no 1 kWh unit except the Jackery at a September price.
decides: It confirms ChatGPT's second answer (DJI Power 1000 V2, $379.99) over its first (EcoFlow DELTA 3 Classic). The DJI has the lowest price per Wh among the 1,800 W-plus units ($0.371/Wh) and the most watts per dollar, on the retailer listing's 2,600 W figure. The Anker C1000 Gen 2 ('best upgrade' in chat 1) cannot be the pick from Anker's store under the four-week rule; its $469.99 Amazon listing stays a row, but Amazon's delivery date was not read. Jackery Explorer 1000 v2 and BLUETTI AC180 drop out at the Amazon prices read today ($559 and $549). Ours: ALLPOWERS P1800 at the table's $395.10 with code is the lowest-priced 1,800 W row from a partner store and places about third on capacity per dollar ($0.386/Wh), behind the DJI and level with or ahead of the EcoFlow ($0.419–0.448/Wh). BLUETTI Elite 100 mini ($360.05 with code, $0.358/Wh) wins only the electronics and light-load segment because of its 700 W outlet. BLUETTI Elite 100 V2 is under $500 only on one Amazon listing ($493, 'with AC Cable'); the other Amazon listing and BLUETTI's store are $549. The DJI is also in Dealectric's list as an amazon:us product, so the top pick is linkable.
